title: PR #33: feat(wallet): convert ATC wallet core to Rust L1 signing
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Scope

- Implements Rust WalletKey with OS CSPRNG and private-key boundary.
- Implements WAL-ADDR-001 address payload/checksum/Base58 primitives.
- Replaces the previous wallet transaction preimage with the current L1 kernel ATC-TX-DOMAIN-V2 layout.
- Uses Ed25519 because the current executable L1 kernel verifier is Ed25519.
- Adds wallet-specific Rust fmt/check/test CI.

## Important protocol finding

WAL-SIGN-001 is still a SPEC-DRAFT that specifies secp256k1/RFC6979/Low-S, while the current L1 kernel implementation verifies Ed25519. This PR follows the executable L1 path and explicitly documents the conflict instead of introducing a non-functional Ethereum-compatible signer.

Concrete address version bytes are also not hard-coded because WAL-ADDR-001 delegates them to ATC-NETWORK-ID-001 and the current contract does not freeze those values.

## Verification

The PR CI must provide the actual cargo fmt/check/test evidence before the wallet integration can be considered CI-verified.
